Root cause: detokenize (line 42) escapes DQUOTE but not BACKSLASH, while tokenize's in-quote escape rule (lines 8-11) consumes BACKSLASH+next-char; an original BACKSLASH immediately preceding an original DQUOTE yields the in-quote sequence BACKSLASH,BACKSLASH,DQUOTE, which tokenize reads as literal-BACKSLASH followed by a region-closing DQUOTE.
search_method: Partitioned every token in the domain (1-3 chars over {a,b,DQUOTE,BACKSLASH}) by which branch of detokenize it takes and by which tokenize behaviors its serialized form exercises. detokenize quotes a token iff it contains DQUOTE (no domain token contains a space or is empty), so the token-level partition is: (A) bare tokens containing neither DQUOTE nor BACKSLASH; (B) bare tokens containing BACKSLASH but no DQUOTE, sub-split by backslash position (start/middle/end); (C) quoted tokens containing DQUOTE but no BACKSLASH, sub-split by quote count and position; (D) quoted tokens containing both BACKSLASH and DQUOTE, sub-split by what follows the backslash inside the token (DQUOTE / a or b or BACKSLASH / end-of-token). List-level partition: 1-token lists, and 2-3-token lists by adjacency pattern across the joining space (bare-bare, bare-quoted, quoted-bare, quoted-quoted). For each class I hand-traced detokenize then tokenize on representatives, tracking i, cur, in_q, started at every step, until a class produced a violation; classes A, B, C and all mixed-adjacency joins of A/B/C tokens were traced to completion and round-trip correctly, so the violation was exhibited from class D.
classes_swept: A: tokens over {a,b} only (e.g. 'a', 'ab', 'bba') — never quoted by detokenize; tokenize outside quotes copies a/b literally and splits on the single joining spaces; round-trips for 1-3 token lists. OUTCOME: no violation.

B: bare tokens containing BACKSLASH but no DQUOTE, backslash at start/middle/end (e.g. '\\', 'a\\b', '\\\\', 'ab\\') — not quoted (line 41 false); outside quotes tokenize has no escape rule (line 8 applies only when in_q), so BACKSLASH is copied literally by line 29; spaces still split correctly. OUTCOME: no violation.

C: tokens containing DQUOTE but no BACKSLASH (e.g. '"', 'a"', '"b', 'a"b', '""', '"""') — quoted by detokenize with each DQUOTE serialized as BACKSLASH,DQUOTE; inside quotes tokenize's escape rule turns each BACKSLASH,DQUOTE back into a literal DQUOTE and the final unescaped DQUOTE closes the region; traced '"' -> '"\\""' -> ['"'] and 'a"b' -> '"a\\"b"' -> ['a"b'] and '""' -> '"\\"\\""' -> ['""']. OUTCOME: no violation.

D: tokens containing both BACKSLASH and DQUOTE — quoted, but the BACKSLASH is left unescaped. Sub-case D1, BACKSLASH immediately before DQUOTE ('\\"'): serialized BACKSLASH,BACKSLASH,DQUOTE; tokenize consumes BACKSLASH,BACKSLASH as escaped-backslash and the DQUOTE closes the region prematurely; full trace above. OUTCOME: VIOLATION (['\\"'] -> ['\\']). Sub-case D2, BACKSLASH before a/b (e.g. '\\a"' -> serialized '"\\a\\""' -> tokenize escape swallows the backslash -> ['a"']). OUTCOME: violation. Sub-case D3, BACKSLASH at token end (e.g. '"\\' -> serialized DQUOTE,BACKSLASH,DQUOTE,BACKSLASH,DQUOTE -> the trailing BACKSLASH escapes the closing delimiter -> ['""']). OUTCOME: violation.
